title: Connect 4 Game — Browser-Based Interactive Game
tagline: Interactive Connect 4 game built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
intro: A browser-based Connect 4 game showcasing dynamic gameplay and responsive design.
summary: Developed across three iterations with jQuery and Bootstrap. Demonstrates DOM manipulation, state management, and responsive UI design. Hosted on GitHub Pages with a public repo.

sections.title: Description
sections.body: Interactive Connect 4 game built for browsers, demonstrating progression in frontend logic and design.

sections.title: Objective / Aim
sections.body: Showcase DOM manipulation, state management, and UI design through an enjoyable mini-game.

sections.title: Role & Responsibilities
sections.body: Coded game logic, designed responsive UI, and iterated improvements across three versions.

sections.title: Impact / Results
sections.body: Serves as a showcase project for portfolio and learning, demonstrating steady growth in frontend skills.
